Visited The 1920's Lounge and unfortunately it wasn’t a great experience for me.
May 2026 • Couples
From the moment I walked in, I was asked if I had a reservation. That’s fine, but it felt unnecessary considering there were only a few people inside. I initially sat at the bar, which was allowed, but the overall atmosphere already felt a bit uncomfortable.
Later, I asked if I could sit in a more comfortable chair further inside. Even though the place was nearly empty, I was told I couldn’t because it was a table for four. I explained I was just having a couple of drinks and would leave shortly, but it still wasn’t possible. Eventually, I was directed to another seat, but by then the experience already felt off.
The place itself is very dark and perhaps designed to feel trendy, but it didn’t work for me. The atmosphere felt cold rather than welcoming.
Service-wise, some staff were fine, but overall the attitude came across as a bit arrogant, which didn’t help the experience.
It might suit others, but personally I wouldn’t return.
